newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DAX ends slightly lower, focus on U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: German DAX ends slightly lower, focus on U.S. data.

text.p: 1240 GMT - German DAX index ends down 0.17 percent, in middle of narrow nine-point day's range, as market continues to seek direction amid consolidation after recent record highs.
* March DAX future down 3.0 points at 3,002.
* Market, still sensitive to dollar moves, waiting for U.S. data this afternoon. Employment costs index due at 1330 GMT, consumer confidence at 1400 GMT.
* Banks under pressure after Deutsche, Commerzbank hold dividends steady, Commerzbank 1996 results lower than expected. Siemens up slightly after Q1 data.
